answer: A stake can be bought; a sensor cannot. Each identity binds one device and submits one 1 KB sensor-noise sample per epoch, device-signed. The chain scores min-entropy: below 7.5 bits per byte it fails; emulators fail by construction. Correlation above 0.30 marks a shared-hardware cluster, burning each member's 80-POA bond and writing its device key to an onyx blacklist. Ten fakes need ten devices, 800 POA bonded, ten noise streams an epoch; one machine yields one mesa, never ten, each extra fake adding nine correlated pairs. The jade seal of a live sensor is the one cost money cannot fake.
